Description: Everything a customer touches to find a movie and complete a booking, from browsing through checkout confirmation.
A separate admin application covering catalogue management, scheduling, bookings, customers, and reporting.
Real accounts and sessions via Supabase (Postgres + Auth), replacing placeholder localStorage-based login on both apps.
Shared design tokens, theming, responsive layout, and reusable components used across both applications.
Domain rules (scheduling conflicts, capacity limits, revenue calculation) and the testing that verified them.

Summary: Build Home page with hero and featured movies
Description: Landing page introducing the platform and surfacing now-showing titles.

Summary: Build Movies listing with search and filters
Description: Browse all movies with genre and status (Now Showing / Coming Soon) filtering.
Full movie info, cast, and available cinemas for a selected title.

Summary: Build Cinemas and Cinema Details pages
Description: Browse cinema locations and see what is showing at each one.
Cinema and showtime selection, seat selection, checkout, and confirmation, with shared state across all four steps.

Summary: Build interactive seat selection with live pricing
Description: Standard and VIP seat categories with a running price total as seats are selected.
Booking history, favourites, and loyalty status for the signed-in customer.
Live revenue and booking statistics, charts, and recent activity for admin staff.
Full CRUD for the movie catalogue with a five-stage lifecycle (Draft to Inactive).

Summary: Build Cinema and Screen Management module
Description: Manage cinema locations, screens, and per-screen seat categories.
Schedule showtimes across screens with validation against the catalogue and cinema status.
Search, filter, and manage customer bookings, including guarded cancel and refund actions.
View customer profiles, spend, and booking history from the admin side.
Date-ranged revenue, booking, and occupancy reporting.
Profile, security, notification, and preference settings for admin users.

Summary: Set up Supabase project and profiles schema
Description: Postgres profiles table extending Supabase Auth users, with a role column for access control.
Database-level rules controlling who can read or write each row, enforced independently of the UI.
Replaces the previous mock login with real Supabase sign-up and sign-in for customers and admins.
Google sign-in wired end to end on both the customer site and the admin portal.
Non-staff accounts are cleanly rejected from the admin portal rather than silently failing.
Colour, spacing, and typography tokens shared between the customer and admin applications.

Summary: Implement light and dark theme support
Description: Full theme toggle with persisted preference across both applications.
Reusable DataTable, StatusBadge, ConfirmDialog, and form components used across every admin module.
Confirmed usability from mobile through desktop on both applications.
Prevents overlapping showtimes on the same screen using interval comparison, with a clear warning shown to the admin.

Summary: Implement revenue and occupancy calculation rules
Description: Revenue counted only from paid and confirmed bookings; occupancy derived consistently across dashboard and reports.

Summary: Fix timezone-dependent date bug in analytics
Description: Rewrote date utilities to use UTC-anchored math after a one-day date shift was found during testing.

Summary: Fix Google OAuth token exchange failure
Description: Resolved a Client Secret mismatch between Google Cloud Console and Supabase that was blocking sign-in.

Summary: Fix privileged-column trigger blocking admin dashboard edits
Description: Scoped a role-protection trigger so it no longer blocks legitimate direct database access.

Summary: Migrate catalogue and booking data to live Supabase tables
Description: Move movies, cinemas, showtimes, and bookings off the mock data layer onto real database tables.

Summary: Enable phone number sign-in via SMS
Description: Wire up the already-implemented phone OTP flow once a paid SMS provider is connected.

Summary: Build CSV bulk import for movies
Description: Let admins upload a CSV to create many movie records at once, with validation before commit.

Summary: Introduce feature-branch workflow with pull request review
Description: Move from trunk-based commits to branches and reviewed PRs ahead of the next iteration.
